game.name: SBK 08 : Superbike World Championship (Europe)
game.desc: SBK'08: SuperBike World Championship on Xbox 360 is the official game of the SuperBike World Champion. The game features 22 bikes and 22 riders on the 12 official tracks with 6 different game modes and 5 levels of realism for everyone to enjoy. Also present, an online mode allowing you to race against your friends via Internet.
